title: routing_config.v1: the routing file, routing.json
description: The file '$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/recursion/routing.json', beside routes.json: a default route, ordered rules, and the logins each engine is billed through, one per engine (grill Q45: a default engine, a routing config the user writes, and a per-task hand pick that always wins; the hand pick is on the task, never in this file). It holds no secret: a login names a connection id, the route contract's route.connection.id. The file must be a regular file of the operator's that no one else can write. Rules the loader (recursion_core.routing.config.load_config) enforces that a schema cannot state: a login's vendor and kind match the credential catalog (the key store's metadata for API keys, the connections routes.json configures for sign-ins); one login per vendor and kind, per connection and per engine; the Claude subscription is bound to claude_code only (grill Q12); the login bound to an engine is the connection routes.json launches that engine with; every route's engine has a login; every fallback route is billed through the configured login of its engine; login ids and rule ids are unique.

version.description: Written as the integer 1. JSON Schema counts 1.0 equal to 1; the loader does not, and refuses 1.0 and true (bad_version).

rules.description: Tried in order. The first rule that matches the task and whose engine is routable is chosen.

undetected_rule.description: What a matching rule whose engine is not routable does. skip: try the next rule, then the default. refuse: the task is refused. A hand pick and the default are never replaced either way.

id.description: A login or rule id. The pattern's $ would also match before a final line break, so line breaks are excluded on their own.

vendor.description: Canonical vendor id, matched exactly: no case folding, no alias.

model.description: A model id the breaker store can record: 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters, no space, no line break.
Null or absent: the model routes.json configures for the engine.

limits.description: The user's limit behaviour and fallback order for this route, in the shape recursion_core.routes.limits validates. Absent: the limits routes.json configures for the engine.

route_contract_engine.description: The engines the route contract itself accepts today (recursion_core.routes.contract.ENGINES): a fallback route is launched by the route service as it is written.

fallback_route.description: A whole route, as the route contract takes it: every structural rule of recursion_core.routes.contract.validate_request is stated here; which login it may name is the loader's (fallback_not_a_login).

allOf.description: pi, hermes and opencode take a profile object.
key_source api_key_helper only on an api_key connection of claude_code.
An api_key connection whose key comes from custody (key_source custody, or absent) names its credential_env.
A passthrough connection is claude_code's only, and names its method.

when.description: Every condition given must hold. task_kind: the task's kind is one of these. tags_all: the task carries every one of these tags.
